title: CCFQA: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual and Cross-Modal Speech and Text Factuality Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the factual consistency and performance drop of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) when answering identical, parallel factual questions across 8 different languages to reveal English-centric performance gaps.

Comparing the accuracy and factual consistency of MLLM responses when the exact same factual query is presented as text versus speech audio to measure performance degradation and alignment across modalities.
